integrity: The general statement is proved by a complete explicit free-face sequence. Known triangle-cycle and large-clique homotopy types are credited, not claimed as new. Priority screening is bounded; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple graphs, a degree-one base vertex, Cartesian product with K_3, and the ordinary open Lovasz neighborhood complex. Arbitrary leafless cores not classified; no equivariant extension asserted. Finite tests support but do not replace a universal elementary-collapse proof.
title: Pendant-edge collapse invariance for triangular-fiber neighborhood complexes
